patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lemlist and Salesloft share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Lemlist only if your buying job matches “Multichannel cold outreach — Email from $55/user/mo yearly; Multichannel from $87/user/mo ” rather than Salesloft's shape. Choose Salesloft only if your buying job matches “Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM sync, seque” rather than Lemlist's shape. Workflow advantage: Lemlist leans shared coverage; Salesloft leans lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lemlist and Salesloft share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Lemlist is Multichannel cold outreach — Email from $55/user/mo yearly; Multichannel from $87/user/mo yearly; Enterprise custom; 14-day trial.; Salesloft is Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM sync, sequencing, coaching; talk-to-sales pricing..
- Company-size focus: Lemlist (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Salesloft (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Lemlist-leaning — vs Salesloft-leaning lead-management.
- Researched limits: Lemlist — Cold-outreach first — not an SI mega-database peer; Salesloft — Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core.

Limitations — Lemlist: Cold-outreach first — not an SI mega-database peer; Lead database included but secondary to multichannel sending; Salesloft: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core; No published dollar pricing — talk-to-sales only.

Poor-fit cases: Lemlist is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cold-outreach first — not an SI mega-database peer · Salesloft is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core · Avoid Lemlist if you actually need Salesloft's motion (Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM s)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
